Class NeoForgeClientSetup

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.client.NeoForgeClientSetup
public final class NeoForgeClientSetup extends Object
Single client lifecycle bootstrap: registers the item-definition types from ClientModelTypes, installs the ClientPlatform seam and the client /sb tree, and reloads client colors on resource reload.
